elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company’s request, provide transition assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided at HDI’s then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: HDI must return all defined Company Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Company Data to be returned in a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return, HDI must delete all Company Data and certify the deletion in writing to the Company.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The clause provides assistance “for up to” six months, which sets a maximum but does not guarantee at least 90 days.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: HDI must return all defined Company Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, satisfying the export requirement.
